'''Holrik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male who lived on the planet of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like many of the local [[Denfrandi]], he lived in a gondola attached to a local herbivore named [[sleft-chuff]], that lived in the upper levels of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] atmosphere. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] Holrik was briefly disturbed when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] landed in his gondola while running for her life. Holrik mistook her for a [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raider]] and told her to go away.<ref name="Wind">''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''</ref>
